## Merge Checklist

- [ ] The PR targets `dev` unless this is an approved production release PR.
- [ ] The linked issue and acceptance criteria match the delivered work.
- [ ] After merge, verify the linked issue state.
- [ ] If GitHub leaves completed work open, close the issue manually as `completed`.
- [ ] If the work is superseded or intentionally abandoned, close it as `not planned` with an explanation.
- [ ] Delete the merged feature branch.
- [ ] Confirm no stale remote branch remains.
